category_title: English language learners who struggle to comprehend abstract literary nuances without visual aids
scenario_title: Inferring abstract literary elements in small group discussion
minimal_context: The student is in a small group discussing a scene from the novel 'Night' to identify literary elements like foreshadowing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We just read the scene in 'Night' where Madam Schacter screams 'Fire!' on the cattle car. What literary element is being used here?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks down at the desk, speaking very quietly) I'm not sure... she is just yelling about a fire.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think her screaming means for the rest of the story?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. Maybe the train is on fire?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Look closely at the text again. Try to figure out what the fire foreshadows.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stays quiet for a long moment, looking confused at the book) I can't tell from the reading. I don't know what it foreshadows about the camps.
